description: This is a shell script for testing Git merge base computations and related Git operations, including setup of commit graphs, merge-base calculations, and advanced use cases like octopus merges and fork-point detection.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Function to create commits with specific offsets and parent relationships, used for setting up the test commit graph.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Function to define test cases expecting success, executing commands and comparing expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Function for comparing expected and actual outputs in tests.
